definition: Unique identifier for the patient.
Unique identifier for the healthcare encounter or visit.
Comma-separated string of unique 3-character ICD diagnosis code prefixes associated with the encounter.
Count of unique 3-character ICD diagnosis code prefixes recorded during the encounter.
Datetime when the encounter began (first recorded activity or admission).
Datetime when the encounter ended (final discharge or completion of visit).
Total length of the encounter in days calculated from encounter start to encounter end.
Clinical setting where care occurred (e.g., Inpatient hospitalization, Observation stay, Outpatient visit, or other in-person care setting).
Primary clinical specialty or hospital service responsible for the encounter (e.g., cardiology, emergency medicine, general surgery).
Chronologically ordered sequence of ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer) event types occurring during the encounter, stored as a pipe-separated string.
Chronologically ordered timestamps corresponding to the ADT events in adt_event_types_seq_str.
Year of birth for the patient.
Recorded sex of the patient (Male or Female).
Recorded patient race and ethnicity category.
Binary indicator of whether the patient is recorded as deceased in the dataset (1 = deceased, 0 = not deceased).
Patient age in years at the start of the encounter.
Number of unique medication orders placed during the encounter.
Chronologically ordered pipe-separated list of procedure codes recorded during the encounter.
Chronologically ordered pipe-separated list of procedure descriptions corresponding to proc_codes_seq_str.
Chronologically ordered timestamps corresponding to each recorded procedure during the encounter.
Total number of procedures performed or recorded during the encounter.
Number of encounters recorded for the patient prior to the current encounter.
Total number of procedures recorded across all prior encounters for the patient.
Total number of ICD diagnosis codes recorded across all prior encounters.
Cumulative number of days spent across all prior encounters.
